title: Invoice redesign live on the 16th
transcript:
[00:00] Elif: Customers keep saying our invoices look like a receipt from 2005.
[00:05] Noah: Fair. The template hasn't changed since we launched.
[00:09] Sunita: The new design is approved. Logo, line items grouped by project, a clear due date.
[00:16] Elif: Then let's get the invoice redesign live on Monday the 16th. Noah owns it.
[00:22] Noah: The 16th is fine.
[00:26] Sunita: I'll send Noah the final assets tomorrow.
[00:30] Elif: And we should warn the accounting firms that parse our PDFs.
[00:35] Noah: I'll email the three firms on the integration list this week.
[00:40] Sunita: Thanks. Do we keep the old layout available as an option?
[00:45] Elif: No. One layout.
[00:49] Noah: Agreed.
